title: Wide Area CMM
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE SUSTAINMENT CENTER.FA8227  AFSC OL H PZIM
description_text: The RAPID Innovation Center at Hill Air Force Base UT has identified a need for a high-accuracy, handheld Wide Area CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine). This acquisition must include operator familiarization and initial calibration.
